title: My Runner Profile
description: Centralize your physiological data, reference times and personal records.

seo.title: Runner Profile — Zoned
seo.description: Your runner profile: physiological data, reference times, benchmark history and personal records.

commute.title: Commute
commute.description: If you bike (or jog) to work, enter the commute here so the generator can account for the recurring load.
commute.durationHint: One-way duration. Double it if you also commute back.
commute.includeInPlanHint: When on, the plan reduces easy sessions to avoid overload. Otherwise, commute stays an untracked extra.
commute.invalid: Pick at least one day and a valid duration

base.title: Base Data
base.description: Your physiological data and current training volume.
base.fcMaxError: Max HR must be between 100 and 250 bpm
base.vmaError: vVO2max must be between 8 and 30 km/h
base.weeklyKmError: Volume must be between 0 and 500 km
base.longRunKmError: Distance must be between 0 and 200 km

references.title: Reference Times
references.description: Your recent times by distance, used to calibrate predictions and paces.
references.label: Race name

benchmarks.title: Test History
benchmarks.description: Track the evolution of your vVO2max tests and other assessments.

dashboard.seoDescription: Everything Zoned keeps on this device: your values, your zones, your favorites, your weeks, your custom workouts and your current plan.
dashboard.title: On this device
dashboard.intro: A few values, a few lists, no account. Everything is written to this browser's local storage: Zoned has no server that knows you, and nothing follows you to another device unless you export it.
dashboard.valuesTitle: My values · the base of every calculation
dashboard.zonesTitle: My zones · derived from your values
dashboard.zonesEmpty: Enter your vVO2max or your max HR to compute your zones.
dashboard.weeksNote: These are compositions, not a log: nothing is marked "done".
dashboard.dataEyebrow: Take it with you or clear it
dashboard.dataTitle: Your data leaves when you decide.
dashboard.dataBody: One JSON file holds everything: values, adjusted zones, favorites, weeks, custom workouts, current plan. It reads back on another device, or archives. Clearing is immediate and final.
dashboard.footerCache: Clearing the browser cache erases this data
dashboard.privateBrowsingWarning: Private browsing: what you enter will disappear when the window closes. Export before you leave.
dashboard.storageDeniedWarning: Storage denied by the browser: Zoned still works, but nothing will be kept between visits.
dashboard.emptyStateBody: A single value is enough to start: your vVO2max, or a recent race time it can be derived from. Everything else is optional.
dashboard.emptyStateNote_one: The catalogue workout stays readable without any data.
dashboard.emptyStateNote_other: The {{count}} catalogue workouts stay readable without any data.

zones.seoDescription: Correct your values and adjust a zone by hand: the formula proposes, you decide.
zones.title: My values
zones.manualAdjustBody: Your Z{{zone}} ({{current}}) differs from the formula ({{formula}}). Sessions in this zone will use your value, not the formula's.
zones.resetZone: Revert this zone to the formula
zones.impactNote: Files already exported keep the old paces: they don't update themselves.
zones.privacyNote: None of these values leave the device. No ranking, no percentile, no comparison.
zones.overlapWarning: Your Z{{lower}} bound overlaps your Z{{upper}}: the same pace would belong to both zones.
zones.overlapOnlyInsists: The only case where Zoned insists: two sessions from different zones would become identical.
zones.suspiciousVma: {{value}} km/h of vVO2max is a very high level for most runners — double-check the value is really in km/h and not another unit.

storage.seoDescription: Line by line, what Zoned writes to this browser's local storage: the key, its content, its size, and what happens if it disappears.
storage.title: {{count}} keys, {{size}}
storage.intro: Line by line, what Zoned writes to this browser's local storage: the key's name, what it contains, its size, and what happens if it disappears.
storage.deleteKeyBody: This key will be removed from local storage immediately. This action cannot be undone.
storage.settingsGroupContent: Language, theme, units, saved filters, last screen — settings, not counted in "my data"
storage.clearsEverything1: Clearing the browser's cache or site data.
storage.clearsNothing1: Closing the tab, restarting the device, going offline.
storage.clearsNothing2: A Zoned update: the format is versioned.
storage.onlyBackupBody: Zoned has no server: the JSON file you export is your backup. Two devices sync by exchanging this file, by hand.

zoned-runner-profile.content: vVO2max, max HR, volume, level, tests and personal records
zoned-runner-profile.consequence: Paces go back to being percentages

zoned-userZones.content: Zone preferences (HR/vVO2max) and your manual adjustments

zoned-favorites.content: IDs of the sessions marked as favorites

zoned-plans.content: Training plans and composed weeks ("My Week" included)
zoned-plans.consequence: The plan regenerates, your edits don't

zoned-cycling-profile.consequence: The plan falls back to default estimates

zoned-swimming-profile.consequence: The plan falls back to default estimates

zoned-commute-pattern.content: Bike or run commute the generator accounts for
zoned-commute-pattern.consequence: The commute is no longer built into the plan

zoned-settings.content: Theme, units, color palette, route generator opt-in

clearAll.title: Clear {{count}} keys
clearAll.body: That's {{objects}} objects: your values, your adjusted zones, your favorites, your weeks, your custom workouts and your current plan. No undo after this.
